messages:
Amanda Chen: Heads-up — Medivar (healthcare platform) pushed back on list pricing. Asking for 45% off a 2yr dedicated commit + 3 months migration credit. Also requires Private deployment (VPC) and SOC2 attestation. Can we fast-track?
Mei Wong: 45% is pretty deep. What's the committed monthly GPU equivalent / ACV? need numbers for deal desk.
Amanda Chen: ACV would be $1.2M ARR (committed), GPU pool equivalent ~120 A100-months/year. They want price to be competitive vs vendor X.
Raj Patel: tagging deal desk — Mei, recommend we treat this as a strategic healthcare anchor (logo + references). Could we do 40% + migrating credits instead?
Mei Wong: For 40% we need exec sign-off. Can you confirm term length (2yr ok?) and whether they want annual payments?
Amanda Chen: 2yr preferred, annual payments likely. They also asked for a clause: ability to reduce committed volume by 20% in year 2 if usage drops.
Carlos Rivera: Margin check: at 40% off + 3 months free onboarding, net margin falls under target if they pay annually. Need projected utilization profile to model.
Evan Brooks: Product note — Private deployment + SOC2 increases ops OPEX in year1. On Dedicated side, we can reserve capacity but the first 3 months will require extra SRE support.
Lina Gupta: Legal: what's the ask on data residency and indemnities? SOC2 attestation is fine but define timeline for evidence. Also flexible-commit reductions need explicit thresholds and notice periods.
Amanda Chen: They want EU + US residency. SOC2 Type II report within 60 days of contract execution. Commit reduction: 60 days notice, max once over contract.
Mei Wong: Proposed commercial: 38% off list for 2yr commit, 3 months migration credit (applied as one-time invoice credit), SOC2 evidence within 60d, one-time 20% reduction allowed in year 2 with 60d notice. This preserves ~7% more margin than 45%. Thoughts?
Raj Patel: I can take 38% to Sales VP for one-touch approval if finance signs off. Amanda — get them to agree to annual prepay and the notice windows in writing.
Carlos Rivera: Run the model with assumed utilization 75% of committed capacity. If results show <target margin, ask for either 40% or remove one-month of migration credit.
Evan Brooks: Also add a line that Private deploy start date must be after a pre-scheduled provision window (we need 6 weeks). If they want earlier, it'll be billed as accelerated onboarding.
Lina Gupta: I'll draft the amendment language for the reduction clause and SOC2 delivery timeline. Will need Amanda to confirm customer legal contacts.
Amanda Chen: Will do — sending draft commercial terms to Medivar today. @dealbot please create approval ticket for 38% discount + migration credit -> tagging Mei and Carlos for sign-off. :pray:
dealbot: Approval ticket created: #AP-7429, status: pending. Assigned: Mei Wong, Carlos Rivera.
Mei Wong: Reviewing ticket now. If finance ok, I will route to VP Revenue for sign-off.
Carlos Rivera: I'll run the margin sim and post by EOD. If we can keep margin >=18% net, I'm good.
Jordan Lee: FYI product capacity note filed — may need to reserve an extra 10% headroom for onboarding. Amanda, please confirm expected production cutover window.
Amanda Chen: Target cutover Q3 week 2. Thanks everyone, will update once Medivar accepts the 38% + conditions.
